steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Lightly grease an 8x4-inch loaf pan.
Beat sugar and shortening with an electric mixer in a mixing bowl until creamy. Sift in flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix in mashed bananas. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, about 1 hour.

raw_recipe.headline: Rich and Delicious Banana Bread
raw_recipe.description: This old family recipe for banana bread without eggs is always a favorite with kids and adults alike. It's rich, delicious, and super easy to make.
raw_recipe.name: Rich and Delicious Banana Bread

review.reviewBody: This recipe is AWESOME. So easy, tastes delicious and never fails. I've been making it often as my house is for sale and it gets the house smelling just wonderful for people walking through. It's very adaptable too. I like to add a touch of cinnamon and vanilla to it and often substitue other fruits for the banana. This morning I used 1 banana, 1 peach and a 1/2 cup of shredded zuchinni and a handful of raisins. Yesterday it was 1 banana and 1 c of zuchinni. Before that it was all zuchinni and a 1/2 c pineapple and raisins. This recipe hasn't failed on me yet!

We really enjoy this recipe at my house, it works really well with brown rice flour and coconut sugar substitutions. I also add half a cup of shaved coconut and half a cup of dark chocolate chunks. We bake it in a brownie pan for 45 minutes and it turns out much nicer.

Fantastic!
I read through others modifications and did decide on a few. 
A few dashes of cinnamon, a splash of milk (we use almond), 3/4tsp vanilla and mini chocolate chips. 
I did cook it longer than an hour in our convection oven as well.... about 10 to 15 minutes before the toothpick came out clean. 
Already had requests from the family to make it again!!!!

This wonderful recipe can be made GLUTEN FREE and VEGAN! 
I made muffins with it and here are the subs I used: 
-Spectrum Shortening instead of regular (it's non-hydrogenated and made with organic palm oil).
-Vegan sugar (regular sugar is made with bone char)
-1.5 c Gluten free flour (Grandpa's Kitchen Flour Blend).
I also added cinnamon and 1 tsp. of vanilla and 2T of coconut milk.
I baked these about 10 minutes less than the regular time and these turned out so moist and tasty and the flavor was great! The whole house smelled like bananas! Next time I will be trying the bread and adding vegan chocolate chips to the mix as well! Thanks for the wonderful recipe! :)
Rich and Delicious Banana Bread by DStoneGove. Add 1/2t vanilla & 1 egg. This is the best. Second is Teri Lynn's Easy Banana Bread. One recipe makes 3 minis, 50mins. E.
Tasted great. Had to substitute coconut oil instead of shortening and added 1tsp of vanilla extract. Will definitely make again!

Ran out of eggs and was craving banana bread!
I halved the recipe and used 2 bananas. Substituted butter for shortening. Added chocolate chips. Baked at 325 for 45 mins then 350 for 10 mins (wanted to get it a bit browner) and it came out great! Will have to try substituting applesauce for the shortening next time as other reviewers have had luck! I did not add extra milk like other reviewers and it worked out well. Once I added the bananas in with the other ingredients it all came together. Awesome recipe for when you're out of eggs! so quick and easy.

Instead of shortening I use 1/4 cup applesauce, 1/4 cup butter also couple tablespoons of milk and flaxseed as an egg replacement a our son is allergic to egg. Also half cup of sugar as we add choc chips or a fruit...Don't overmix;)

Made it for my staff. They LOVED it. I used softened butter because I didn't have shortening on hand, added mini chocolate chips and an extra banana because the bananas I had were on the smaller side. I baked it in a bundt pan because it makes a pretty cake/loaf and I didn't have my loaf pan. It took 45 minutes to bake at 325 degrees - I would suggest checking it at that time - otherwise you risk over-baking your bread which means it will be dry. 

Will definitely continue to use this recipe!

Delicious. We made this with the following substitutions:

Butter instead of shortening
A few tablespoons molasses and less sugar
Baking powder instead of baking soda
Half cup of whole wheat flour substitution for white
Giant squirt of vanilla extract
Pecan halves on top
Round cake pan instead of loaf
45 min cook time instead of 60

That's a lot of substitutions. My apologies, was working with what I had and trying to get a few healthier ingredients in - all in a hurry. It still tasted great!

Excellent! I was skeptical of making bread without an egg. My husband said this was the best banana bread he had ever had. He liked it because it wasn't too sweet.

-I omitted the butter and instead added a single serving of cinnamon applesauce (about 1/2 a cup).

-I added a tsp of vanilla for flavor

-I also added 1/2 a cup of finely chopped walnuts

I added the rest of the ingredients and made into muffins. Turned out perfect!
Maybe I did it wrong, but...as it cooled, it collapsed upon itself. It appeared to be fully cooked but was still kinda gummy.
Very simple but excellent 👌

I’ve made a lot of different banana bread recipes, and they all were baked at 350ºF, this recipe calls for 325ºF. I started out at 325ºF, but after 20 minutes got a little concerned about how long it was going to take for this to bake, so I then bumped up the temperature to 350ºF. In total, this still took 1 hr 25 mins to bake, testing with a toothpick inserted in the bread’s center. It actually does taste rich, but the consistency is unlike any banana bread I’ve ever made. It was falling apart, so couldn’t be handheld. It is quite tasty almost a bit decadent tasting, but I think I’ll stick with one of my more traditional banana bread recipes.
I have been making this for years but I use a 1/2 cup of applesauce instead of shortening to make it a little bit healthier. It is a moist banana bread that my kids love!
It worked out really really good. Added vanilla!

Hands down the best recipe ever I’ve tried so many and keep using this one for my go to for many many years my mom and her mom have Always made it this way I will continue using this recipe and pass it down to my children and my grandchildren

This is a nice recipe and very easy. Also great if you don't have butter or eggs on hand. I don't care for 3 bananas, so I use 1 banana + an equal amount of applesauce and 1 small container of plain greek yogurt. It takes about 1.25 hours at 325.

Personally it was a bit lacking in the banana flavor intensity. I made it with wheat flour instead of regular flour (which I don't recommend unless you're on a diet or something). Not bad but definitely not the best banana bread recipe I've tried.
Love it!
